2027_transition.description: single RT exam replaces TMC+CSE Jan 2027, new fee $360/$300 repeat - upcoming shift in what buyers need prep for

content_components.description: pre-test + review outlines + appendices + study schedule (Kettering); full practice exams with explanations + clin sims with rationale (Lindsey Jones); mastery quizzes + practice tests (RT Board Review)

entry_level_pdfs.description: beginner guides with case studies/troubleshooting ($14, 73pg Etsy); flashcard decks ($5.21/494 cards); single-domain question packs ($7, RTZ)

organic_channels.description: reddit recurring threads naming specific products; TikTok hashtag + shop; RT program FB groups; YouTube study-plan videos; Etsy market/keyword aggregator pages

funnel_pattern.description: free practice exam/content used to upsell a paid guide (Mometrix, RTZ)

visible_volume_proxies.description: Lindsey Jones 14,403 units sold; RTZ 1,003 reviews across 41 products; RTZ Test Bank 180 reviews, Bundle 55 reviews

ip_constraints.description: NBRC prohibits reproducing/selling actual copyrighted exam items and enforces an exam security policy; the content outline itself is public and free to use as a structure

authorship_credibility.description: incumbents feature named, credentialed RRTs as authors/contributors

disclaimer_patterns.description: 'independent, not affiliated with/endorsed by any certification body' (NBC-HWC-style pattern); simple 'trademarks of their respective owners' footer (Mometrix)

tam_proxy.description: NBRC administered 23,302 exams and awarded 13,065 new credentials in 2024 across all credential types; RRT/CRT dominate exam volume

market_size_estimate.description: Datanyze estimates RTZ revenue ~$3.7M/yr, 11 employees (unverified methodology, used only as a rough ceiling)

origin.description: RTZ founded 2016, grew via free content ('99.9% free') before layering paid test bank/bundles; claims 100M people reached

incumbent_evolution.description: Kettering (founded 1979) started as in-person seminars, added digital formats later; Lindsey Jones still runs live seminars alongside its packaged kit

enforcement_precedent.description: NBRC shut down a paid Facebook group monetizing copyrighted exam content in 2023

trade_secret_policy.description: exam questions are treated as trade secret; candidates sign non-disclosure; violations can void a credential

trademark_use.description: CRT(R)/RRT(R)/TMC(R) are marks used by incumbents with registration symbols; a seller should avoid implying NBRC affiliation or endorsement

liability_exposure.description: clinical content errors (vent settings, dosing, blood gas interpretation) carry indirect patient-safety/liability risk beyond IP risk

smallest_viable_version: The smallest viable version is a single $7-$15 PDF built around one high-weight NBRC TMC content-outline domain (e.g., the 50%-weighted 'Initiation and Modification of Interventions' section), with 50-100 original practice questions and rationales written from Dustan's own clinical/RRT knowledge rather than reproduced NBRC items, carrying a plain 'independent, not affiliated with or endorsed by NBRC' disclaimer, and listed on Etsy/Gumroad. It launches with zero ad spend by seeding links into the recurring Reddit r/respiratorytherapy 'what did you use'/'failed my TMC' threads, RT program Facebook groups, and a short TikTok/YouTube study-tips clip - the same organic channels RTZ, RT Board Review, and small Etsy sellers already ride.
